No. 2062/35 – FRIDAY, MARCH 16, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDEMENT) ACT NO. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: ARA/LND/ACQV1/D3/45.
Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose:
Description of land or servitude to be acquired:

Two Block of lands are called Udaviharatenna and Nindulekumburehena about 2.0679 Hectares in extent depicted as Lot 01, 03 and 05 in P. P. K Plan Number 3555 and dated 30.03.2017 made by the Senior Superintendent of Surveyor and situated in the Village of Pallepamunuwa in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 33-C, Ruwandeniya, in the Minor Division of Madapaththu, in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Aranayaka, in the District of Kegalle in Sabaragamuwa Province.

Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Udaviharatenna; Description: Land has been acquired under Section 38(A) of the Land Acquisition Act. H. P. Thilakarathna who is a resident of D1/6 Dampahena, Ruwandeniya, Dewanagala is a preliminary claimant; Extent: 1.2121 Hectares for the completion of acquisition activities.

Lot No. 03 Name of the Land: Udaviharatenna; Description: Land has been acquired under Section 38(A) of the Land Acquisition Act. H. P. Thilakarathna who is a resident of D1/6 Dampahena, Ruwandeniya, Dewanagala is a preliminary claimant; Extent: 0.0223 Hectares for the completion of acquisition activities.

Lot No. 05 Name of the Land: Nindulekumburehena; Description: Land has been acquired under Section 38(A) of the Land Acquisition Act. N. Senarathna who is a resident of Ruwandeniya, Dewanagala and others are preliminary claimants; Extent: 0.8335 Hectares for the completion of acquisition activities. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Aranayaka on the 19th day of April, 2018 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate)

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Land Ministry Reference No.: 4-3/15/2014/L/301. Divisional Secretary Ref. No.: KMB/LAN/ACQUI/02/76.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose:

Description of the Land or Servitude to be Acquired: The allotment of the land mentioned below depicted in PP MR 2703, situated in the No. 330 Kamburupitiya Grama Niladhari Division, in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Kamburupitiya in the Matara District in the Southern Province.
Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Ratalankawattha; Description: Open bare land; Name & Address of the land Claimed by: Land Reform Commission; Extent: 0.996 Hectare.
Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Ratalankawattha; Description: Home garden, Permanent well; Name & Address of the land Claimed by: Land Reform Commission; Extent: 0.0016 Hectare.
All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing,

before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Kamburupitiya on the 02nd day of April, 2018 at 9.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 28th day of March, 2018, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computations of such amount. N.H.M.W.W.N. HERATH KUMARI, Divisional Secretary, Kamburupitiya. 12th March, 2018. Divisional Secretariat, Kamburupitiya. 03-1326
